# Oramusa

> Oramusa is a software and website studio serving businesses in the United States.

Oramusa builds professional small-business websites, custom software, AI and automation solutions, and provides ongoing technology support.

## Website services
- Professional small-business websites
- $0 upfront website plan with $99 monthly pricing
- Managed hosting, SSL, mobile optimization, basic on-page SEO, maintenance, contact or quote forms, and limited content updates
- 12-month initial service term, then month-to-month

## Products
- QRTurnover — QR-powered turnover operations for short-term rental hosts and cleaners: https://www.qrturnover.com
- UWAYS — software product in the Oramusa portfolio
- AppraisalIQ — residential appraisal analysis software in development
